QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Eliminating the Rebels
QuestInfo.0: #p2150003# appears somewhat suspicious. Inform #b#p2152016##k of what you know.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152016# is convinced that #p2150003# is building a bomb to terrorize the Black Wings, and he wants you to #rdestroy the dangerous item#k that #p2150003# is making. First, you have to #bwitness what he's doing by raiding the #m310000003# at 6 pm (UTC).
QuestInfo.2: #p2150003# was looking for #o5100002# in order to research how to provide extra heat to expedite the hair-perming process.

0.1: Freedom? Aha! He IS a member of that darned Resistance! How dare #p2150003# stand up against the Black Wings? He'll have to be taught a lesson. You'll help, of course, I presume.

0.1: He is rebelling just for fun? He must be out of his mind. He needs to be sent to a mental hospital!

yes.0: I want you to #braid the #m310000003# at 6 PM sharp#k and catch #p2150003# red-handed! Then, #rdestroy whatever he is making#k. I'll bet it's a bomb... It might not look like a bomb, but I'll bet it is one. Whatever, if anything seems like it doesn't belong at the #m310000003#, just destroy it!

no.0: You refuse...? Are you one of the dissidents too?

1.0: What? #p2150003# was studying perm techniques so he would have more freedom with hair styles? And he wants to be compensated for the destruction of his hard-to-get #o5100002# enemies? Ugh.

yes.0: Let's just pretend that none of this happened!

default.0: Have you not gone to #b#m310000003##k yet? We have word that #p2150003# will be making something inside the #m310000003# at #b6 PM#k, so raid him at that exact time.
